senses.gloss:
पूग पूग, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 1. पू;
but cf. पुञ्ज), an association, union, assembly, cor-
poration; a heap, quantity, multitude; disposition,
property, nature; the Areca or betel-nut tree, Areca
Catechu [cf. ताम्बूल]; the Jaka tree, Artocarpus
Integrifolia; = छन्द or छन्दस्; (आस्), m. pl. a
number of persons; (अम्), n. the Areca-nut, com-
monly called betel-nut.
—पूग-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्,
made into a heap or collection, assembled, collected,
heaped.
—पूग-पात्र, अम्, n. a betel-box (=
फरुवक); a spitting-pot, spittoon (commonly
called पिकादिनी).
—पूग-पीठ, अम्, n. ‘betel-
stool,’ a spitting-pot, spittoon (chewing the Pān
producing an increased excretion of saliva).
—पूग-
पुष्पिका, f. betel-nut and flowers (presented to the
principal guests at a marriage festival).
—पूग-फल,
अम्, n. the fruit of the Areca Catechu, the Areca-nut.
—पूग-रोट, अस्, m. or पूग-रोटक, अस् or अम्,
m. or n. (?), ‘resembling the Areca Catechu,’ the
marshy date tree, Phœnix or Elate Paludosa (=
हिन्ताल; also read पूग-वोट).
—पूग-वैर,
अम्, n. enmity against many.

पूगतिथ, अस्, ई, अम्, see Pāṇ. V. 2, 52; [cf.
गणतिथ, बहुतिथ.]

पूग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, (at the end of a comp.) be-
longing to a multitude.
